title: Completeness of ordinary pullback on the primitive integral domain
statement: For a separated locally finite-type quasi-compact morphism f:X -> Y, ordinary completed-coefficient pullback of a finite-Tor constructible integral complex, or the scalar tensor unit, is derived complete. This concerns the ordinary object and no completion or adjunction-unit morphism.

source.place: Section 6.5, Lemmas 6.5.5 and 6.5.9; Stacks proetale.tex Tag 099N, ordinary-operation completeness step

proof.text: For the finite-Tor input, apply finiteTorAffineProjectiveCharts to K and K on each affine open of Y. Project its two-input conclusion to the first input. For the unit input retain its defining equality. Apply projective-chart pullback transport to obtain explicit bounded finite-free-retract models for ordinary ringed pullback on every leaf cover over every affine open of X. No preservation of infinite products by inverse image is asserted.

Every displayed model is complete by boundedProjectiveComplex_complete. The canonical completion-unit criterion and naturality transport invertibility of the completion unit through its specified model isomorphism. Cancelling the completion of that isomorphism gives completeness on the chart.
Apply affineTreeCompleteDetection to those chartwise completeness proofs. It descends along the finite constructible tree and then along all affine opens, with empty leaves included.

proof_origin.place: H8: restore finite-projective model argument of Lemmas 6.5.5--6.5.8; remove the unsupported general-completeness route. Assembly is explicit Lean from local model construction, bounded-projective completeness, and affine-tree detection.
